sub_service: Garbage collection complaints, including overcharging complaints
problem_type: Uncollected garbage, overcharging for garbage collection
description: LMC's own website confirms a Mayor's Office helpline specifically named for garbage-collection complaints, including overcharging: the site states in Hindi that if anyone demands extra money for garbage collection after online payment, a complaint can be filed at this helpline. Also offers an online complaint portal (via EverythingCivic) with status tracking. No numeric SLA published.
procedure: File online via the complaint portal, or call the Mayor's Office helpline directly (particularly for garbage-collection overcharging).
